claims.claim: Sumsub's published Basic plan is $1.35 per verification with a $149 minimum monthly commitment, positioned for non-regulated businesses
Sumsub's published Compliance plan is $1.85 per verification with a $299 minimum monthly commitment, positioned for regulated businesses, and includes AML screening and proof of address
Sumsub's Enterprise plan is a custom rate not published on the pricing page
Sumsub phone verification adds $0.04 per applicant plus $0.04 per successful verification, plus SMS notification fees of $0.09 to $0.54 depending on country price tier (tiers 1-5)
Sumsub ongoing AML monitoring adds $0.08 per initial check and per subsequently checked match
At 1,000 verifications per month, Sumsub Basic costs $1,350 (1,000 x $1.35, above the $149 minimum) and Compliance costs $1,850
claims.method: arithmetic from the two published per-verification prices; verified with bc before publication

claims.claim: Sumsub describes itself as an identity verification and trust platform covering KYC, KYB, AML screening, transaction monitoring, fraud prevention, Travel Rule, orchestration, case management, and analytics

SEON describes itself as an AI fraud prevention and AML compliance platform built on 1,100+ real-time signals, covering customer screening, payment screening, transaction monitoring, and case management
Persona describes itself as a flexible and secure way to verify real people and real businesses online, with a modular platform covering government ID, Document AI, selfie checks, and database checks

Veriff describes itself as an enterprise identity verification platform supporting 12,500+ documents from 230+ countries and territories in 50 languages, with AML screening against sanctions, PEPs, and adverse media
Shufti (formerly Shufti Pro) describes itself as a global identity verification platform for KYC and AML, spanning KYC, KYB, KYI, ongoing monitoring, and FRAML
SanctionsAI pricing: free 5 checks/day with no signup, Dev $19/mo for 10,000 checks, Pro $99/mo, x402 $0.05/check
SanctionsAI response latency is sub-100 ms and the service is MIT-licensed and self-hostable
SanctionsAI coverage: 1,066 digital-currency address listings (1,050 unique addresses) from the SDN Advanced XML dated 2026-10-02, plus 16 embargoed jurisdictions
claims.method: count of Feature elements with FeatureType 'Digital Currency Address - *'; same dataset published at /data/ofac-crypto-wallets/ and refreshed 2026-10-05
